result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M when IBM processes Customer data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing risk-of-loss language. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after the term is not in the playbook and is broader than necessary, particularly for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation coverage. Otherwise, the provision is clear and professionally drafted.
